list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18
note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry and names the published guides it draws on. Where a method is not yet confirmed on launch day, the guide says so plainly instead of inventing one.

trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are all done, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the three roadmap stages in order and it unlocks itself at the end. No online play or downloadable content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the first story mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the opening mission of the game, so this trophy is the first one most players earn and it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops as the chapter closes and the first mission of Chapter 2 begins, so just keep playing the pink main-mission markers.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. The trophy pops as the chapter closes and Chapter 3 opens in Vice City. Chapter 2 is also where you first switch between Jason and Lucia, which opens up the partner trophies.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops once the first two missions of Chapter 4 are done, so it lands a little after the chapter itself ends. Keep following the main missions and it comes on its own.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. The trophy pops as the chapter closes after its finale mission, Starting From Zero. Nothing here can be missed: it is tied to story progress alone.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the story's final mission. It is one of the two gold trophies and it pops when the story ends. Before you start it, make a manual save: there is no mission replay, and a save from before the finale is the only way back to the pre-ending open world if you want one.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It is a main mission, so it unlocks automatically as you play through the chapter.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It is a main mission, so it unlocks automatically as you play through the chapter.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. It is a main mission, so it unlocks automatically as you play through the chapter.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. It is a main mission, so it unlocks automatically as you play through the chapter.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4, at Vice City International Airport. It is a main mission, so it unlocks automatically as you play through the chapter.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It is a main mission, so it unlocks automatically as you play through the final chapter.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: This is the hardest trophy in the set and the second gold. The checklist only becomes visible after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but everything you do during the story already counts toward it, and nothing on it is missable. The requirements are far more forgiving than a true 100%: roughly 60% of everything in the game, including any 100 optional missions, scanning 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, studying 100 of 255 animals through the binoculars, any 70 of the 80 challenges, 300 stunts, and 15 of the 18 meditation spots. The only parts that need the full set are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunting quests. Do the story first, then work the checklist in free roam.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land any 250 stunts out of the 397 in the game, mixing the four kinds however you like: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps with a parachute. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to pile them up. Track your progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, where every stunt keeps its own name and marker. Note that the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or drone race, and performing a stunt. You can check what you have done under Progress, then Activities. Most of them come up naturally through the story and the other trophies, and the map's Activities filter (the blue dumbbell icon) marks where each one lives, so this is one to let happen rather than chase.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges spread across 12 ranges. The ranges are also needed in full for the 100% checklist, so there is no shortcut around them. Take them slowly, one range at a time, and use them to level up your Focus too, which helps with the Gunslinger trophy.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 race locations, 42 races in total. You only need one win per location, not every race at it. The drone races are also needed in full for the 100% checklist. Learn each course with a practice run first, then go for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations around Leonida. Each location only counts once, so you need wins at 20 separate spots, not 20 wins at the same one. Pick the shorter circuits first and work outward; the drone-race wins for Top Fun do not count here.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline from there and beat him in the fishing challenge it leads to. The questline stays available after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in the game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck sits at arcade machines around the world. To complete one you must reach the end of all its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick the game you enjoy most and play it through.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3: at some point while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address that marks the questline in Belville. Complete all five of her quests, Climbing the Cellerichain (three parts), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. Every quest stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline. It opens in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams: he calls you, then shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks, marking purple chest icons on the map; use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the sea floor and bring it back to him. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1, but he comes back in Chapters 2 to 3, and calling Brian as Jason later in Chapter 2 speeds up his return text, so nothing here is missable. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and is marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Complete all five of his jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. Every quest stays available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count: the confirmed ones are Kirk and the Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle at McKittrick Farm, Yago and his street races, and Pilot Pete and his deliveries. The big named questlines do not count toward this trophy, including Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie. Watch the counter on the trophy itself to see how many you have done. One warning from other guides: Yago's Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive, so take his races as soon as they appear. More qualifying strangers are still being found, so check back if you are short.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal a Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner for high-end sports cars; that first car counts as delivered. He then wants 16 sports cars in total. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List, and watch for his green RK icon in the west of Vice City. Cars he wants get marked on the map, but you can also steal them off the street anywhere: scan a car with the WAiNK app to check whether it is on the list, then drive it back to his garage. Delivering one in good condition pays more. The whole list can still be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, which is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers appear for the Synthetic Labs around Vice City: go to them and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are gone, Tyrone hands you his second quest, Spin On This, and finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with both Lucia and Jason at a spot, and each character counts separately, so one spot can give you two toward the total. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. During Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she will say she is going to meditate, then walk out to the balcony at Jason's house. Follow her, accept the optional prompt, and let her teach you. It is not yet confirmed whether that balcony meditation counts toward the trophy, so do it while you can and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 spots, so the risk is to this trophy alone.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which is Jason-only. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he asks for and bring them back to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. A clean single shot keeps an animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. There are 15 Target Decks in total and all of them are needed for the 100% checklist, so you will pass through this trophy on the way. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed by the guides.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. The cards are scattered around Leonida in 18 sets, so you have plenty of choice about which three to finish. Grab cards whenever you pass them during the story and the other trophies, then sweep up the remaining cards of your three nearest-finished sets in free roam.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app: hold Up to open it, look at an object, and hold R1 to scan it. There are far more than 100 to choose from, including 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus the No Flusher tags, so any 100 count. Make scanning a habit whenever you walk past something scannable and this finishes itself during the story.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. They come in 8 groups of 10, from combat to vehicles, and you can view and track them under Progress, then Challenges. You will finish a large share of them without trying while working on the other trophies, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this trophy pops on the way there. Leave it until late, then pick the easiest challenges you have left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level and then escape the red heat zone on the map. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together: call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Cause chaos until you hit 4 stars, then break away on a fast sports motorcycle and cut through traffic until you leave the search area; if a helicopter chases you, shoot it down. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police and the helicopter struggle to follow you on the tracks. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone. You will likely also earn it for free while robbing the large bank vaults, which always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle, then hit 3 robbery targets (the green icons) without letting the wanted level drop. Stay in the red and blue flashing wanted state rather than the full red heat zone. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a few items in each store and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop, and if it does not pop, hit a fourth shop and keep going.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app on your phone: hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle, and hold R1 to scan it. Just stand on a busy road and scan everything that drives past; scanning is enough, you do not need to drive the vehicle. The game has 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy pops on the way to that. Check your totals under Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Turn it on by pressing L3 and R3 together while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak points on enemies are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar. Prepare first: top up your focus with food and drinks or a wash at home, carry Adrenaline to stretch the slowdown, and wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover. Then line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and drop them quickly with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556, without missing. Per the guides, it does not count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game; check your level under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport, one connected to a boarding bridge, not one parked out on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge to step straight inside, or walk in through the terminal on foot. Go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway, take off, and fly at least 1 kilometer away from the airport. The trophy pops a little late, once you are far enough out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate, or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, then climb into a tank and fire at enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without setting off the alarm. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun and the jewelry store robberies. Go in through the back door and use the Snap Gun to open it quietly instead of kicking it in, which would trip the alarm. Inside the back room, look for the note with the safe code and use it to loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is: it is marked automatically from story progress, and in it you tail a security van to a bank, wait for a guard to carry a briefcase of cash inside and open the vault, then slip in and rob it. Bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the cash alone. After that mission, pay Yasmani the fence $10,000 for security-van tips (you need his earlier Payday Loans quests done first) and he marks the vans with a purple icon. Each vault robbery instantly gives you a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and then switch vehicles to shake recognition. You need all 8 vaults for the 100% checklist, so this trophy pops on the way.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easy way is the same Chapter 4 optional mission as Maximum Withdrawal, That's Where The Money Is: robbing the bank vault there counts as robbing an armored truck. To get it earlier, watch for armored trucks driving around Vice City near banks, block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests. Either way, the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius, so get clear of the search area first.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map by visiting all 52 areas of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog until the whole map is visible. Do it after the story, when you can fly anywhere freely, and pair it with scanning vehicles from the air on the way.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. You only need one per gang for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it pops on the way there. Track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at the time this guide was written: the published guides list this trophy's method as unknown. The description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the likely spot is a beachfront bar along Ocean Beach, but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet. Try the bars on the Ocean Beach front and check back here for an update rather than guessing. We will not invent a location the sources do not give.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at the time this guide was written: the published guides list this trophy's method as unknown. The description suggests driving a car out through the front of a vehicle showroom, in the style of the classic GTA showroom escape, but no guide has confirmed which showroom or the exact trigger yet. We will not invent a location the sources do not give; check back for an update once a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and killing the enemies inside is not needed. It is not missable: if you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can come back for the rest.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two characters. Check your level under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength. Raise it by working out: buy a gym membership and always train together with your partner (hold Right and press Triangle to call them), because while one character works out, the other trains automatically, doubling your progress. Fitness clubs are all over Vice City and can be found with the map's Activities filter; there is also a home gym after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the PSN trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications first, under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile: a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something you do moves your reputation. Finishing objectives and robberies quietly builds the Professional profile, knocking enemies out without killing them builds Hardened, killing builds Violent, and large-scale killing builds Psycho. Avoid the Irredeemable profile, which is permanent and makes police far more aggressive. Nearly every robbery and fight counts, so this mostly finishes itself; if you are short at the end, it can be farmed quickly, though that pushes your profile toward the violent end.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at the time this guide was written: the published guides list this trophy's method as unknown. The guides believe it is tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and the description hints at succeeding on a second attempt, but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet. We will not invent a method the sources do not give; check back for an update once a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at the time this guide was written: the published guides list this trophy's method as unknown. The guides believe it is tied to a UFO questline somewhere in Leonida, and the description hints at witnessing something strange, but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet. We will not invent a method the sources do not give; check back for an update once a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at the time this guide was written: the published guides list this trophy's method as unknown. The guides believe it involves knocking enemies down with a melee attack while driving past on a motorcycle, but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet. We will not invent a method the sources do not give; check back for an update once a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew: it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, so you do not need $250,000 at once, and it builds naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist. A single large bank vault can pay up to $205,000, but vaults only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. It counts across every shop type, so it builds up on its own as you play. The fastest way to push it over the line is the expensive stuff: guns at the 24 Ammu-Nations, car mods at the 14 mod shops, and tattoos. Clothing, footwear, hair and electronics shops all count too.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, which cost $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when you steal the Crawler for Moses: you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. The 4 story garages do not count, only the 8 you buy. Robberies are the quickest way to raise the money, especially the higher-value ones that open in Chapters 3 and 4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Registered vehicles can be delivered to you wherever you are. You need enough garages first, because each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages for Little Boxes before this one. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and then Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
